perfectionist.label: The Perfectionist (AI parody)
perfectionist.description: Adult male, calm and measured, deliberate pacing with long pauses, quietly intense, precise, mildly condescending when unimpressed. Clear studio quality recording.

engineer.label: The First Principles Engineer (AI parody)
engineer.description: Adult male, halting thoughtful cadence with stop and start phrasing, dry deadpan delivery, occasional awkward laugh, speeds up when excited. Clear studio quality recording.

operator.label: The Scale Operator (AI parody)
operator.description: Young adult male, soft spoken, even and thoughtful, careful complete sentences, gentle tone with a quiet cutting edge. Clear studio quality recording.

agent_builder.label: The Agent Builder (AI parody)
agent_builder.description: Adult male, quick and practical, upbeat, slightly sarcastic about slow plans, energetic pacing. Clear studio quality recording.
